== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Jawa (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Jawa (Light) (Premiere)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/jawa__lightside_japanese_white_border/50649 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/4f32944d448e429bae2e8498ab4d5a20/IMG_20220607_0122.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(18, 10, 764, 1052)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c6170237c7fe5d0bbcdabe0ea367474dd590b028ec92fcc021aaf24066688faa</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
